Zapp IPTV - UX Scenario

App ID: com.zappiptv.tv   Version: 1.0.0   Type: web app (webOS 5.0+, 1280x720 rendered full screen)

Zapp IPTV is a video player for the user's own IPTV playlists (M3U or Xtream Codes). It does not provide content: it ships with a sample playlist of free-to-air public Brazilian channels streamed by the channels themselves, so it can be tested without any account.

Flow

Launch → intro animation (about 3 s, any key skips) → Home → Live TV → select a channel → Player. Settings is reachable from the gear icon in the header.

Remote control

KeyAction
Arrows / OKMove focus / open the focused item
BackCloses one level at a time (dialog, side panel, controls, player, section); on Home asks to exit
Left / Right in playerChange channel (live) or seek 10 s (movies/episodes)
Up / Down in playerShow controls and the channel card
Channel + / -, numbersChange channel / go to channel number
RedSearch: opens the search field of the current section (in the player, closes the player and searches the section of what was playing)
GreenProgram guide (in the player)
YellowAdd/remove favorite: focused channel, movie or series, the open details, or what is playing
Play, Pause, Stop, FF, RWPlayback control

Authentication

None. No account, login or payment is needed. Optional parental control PIN (default 0000) can lock categories.

1. Home

Opens after the intro animation with the sample playlist of free public channels already loaded. Focus starts on "Live TV". Arrows move between Live TV / Movies / Series and the Continue watching, Recent channels and Favorite channels shelves. OK opens the focused item; Yellow adds/removes the focused channel or title from favorites; Red opens the search. Back on this screen asks "Exit Zapp IPTV?" (Cancel / Exit).

2. Live TV - channel list

Categories on the left, channels on the right. Up/Down moves through channels, Left/Right switches between categories and the list, OK starts playback, the Yellow key adds/removes a favorite, the Red key opens the search field. Back returns to Home.

3. Player

Full-screen live playback. Left/Right and Channel +/- change channel; number keys jump to a channel. Up/Down shows the controls and the channel card (current program, progress, next program); controls hide after 5 seconds. Play/Pause/Stop/FF/RW keys control playback. The Yellow key adds/removes the current channel from favorites; the Red key closes the player and opens the search. Back hides the controls, then closes the player.

4. Player - channel list

The Channels button in the player controls (or Up/Down to show the controls, then OK on Channels) opens the channel list on the side; Up/Down and OK switch channel without leaving the player, and the Yellow key favorites the focused channel. The Green key opens the program guide. Back closes the side panel.

5. Settings - playlists

Settings (gear icon) manages playlists: Xtream Codes login or M3U URL. Text fields open the on-screen keyboard only when OK is pressed (OK again confirms). No login is required to use the app: the sample playlist works out of the box.
